customManagers.description: The Rust toolchain is pinned by an explicit `toolchain: X.Y.Z` input on every dtolnay/rust-toolchain step (see .github/workflows/*.yml). This tracks that single version string across all workflows so Renovate raises one PR to bump them together. The dtolnay action SHA itself is tracked by the standard github-actions manager via the `# master` comment.

packageRules.description: The oxc AST/formatter stack is pinned to a single git rev (synced to the oxfmt release tag by the auto-update-oxfmt workflow); per-crate updates can never pass CI. The #1550 explicit matchPackageNames list still did not suppress the PRs (#1563/#1564) because for cargo GIT dependencies Renovate's packageName is the repository URL, not the crate name. Match on depName (crate name) AND on the repo-URL packageName, and disable all update types. oxc_resolver / oxc_sourcemap / oxc-miette / oxc_index stay Renovate-managed (registry deps, deliberately not listed).

The lint oracle must stay on the TypeScript major that @typescript-eslint/parser still declares as a peer (>=4.8.4 <6.1.0); a v7 bump makes `npm install` fail ERESOLVE and takes the whole Lint parity job down.

The lint oracle must stay on ESLint 9 until eslint-plugin-svelte stops calling SourceCode.isSpaceBetweenTokens, which ESLint 10 removed; upgrading makes every positive no-reactive-functions report throw instead of producing an oracle result.

The svelte-check oracle must stay on a TypeScript major that svelte-check still declares as a peer (^5 || ^6); a v7 bump makes `npm install` fail ERESOLVE and takes the whole svelte-check parity job down.
Same suppression keyed on the git-source packageName (cargo git deps resolve packageName to the repo URL).

The npm `oxfmt` package (and its `@oxfmt/*` platform bindings) is bumped exclusively by the auto-update-oxfmt workflow, which also syncs the pinned `oxc_formatter` git rev in Cargo.toml to the matching `oxfmt_v<version>` oxc commit and honours a release-age stability window. A standalone Renovate bump (e.g. #1657) can never pass CI: it leaves the oxc rev on the old commit (rsvelte's native CSS formatting diverges from the delegated oxfmt oracle) and races the release-age policy. Disable all Renovate updates for it.

The lint oracle reproduces eslint-plugin-svelte's own environment, so `globals` tracks the version the pinned plugin resolves: submodules/eslint-plugin-svelte at tag eslint-plugin-svelte@3.23.0 locks globals at 14.0.0/15.15.0/16.4.0 and no 17.x. Four harness files import it, and the lint ratchet key is (rule, line, column, message), so an oracle-side bump moves the baseline with no rsvelte change (#3994). Bump it with eslint-plugin-svelte, as one deliberate oracle move with a re-baseline.

ubuntu-22.04 is load-bearing at 15 sites: 14 release/publish matrix entries (release.yml x10, release-capi.yml x2, publish-vscode.yml x2) and one mirror of them, ci.yml's glibc-floor job, which builds a shipped binary the same way and asserts GLIBC_FLOOR=2.35. Renovate's github-actions manager sees only the bare `runs-on:` in ci.yml and not the 14 `os:` values inside the release matrices, so it can only ever raise the 1-of-15 PR that breaks the mirror (#3882) - and check-glibc-floor.sh is designed to go red on it. Move all 15 in one PR and re-derive the floor when 22.04 is retired.
